data.title: Avena
data.about:
Avena 2 at The Valley Dubai features elegant 4-bedroom villas designed for sustainable living, seamlessly blending modernity with nature. This newly launched phase offers contemporary elegance, providing a harmonious lifestyle amidst lush landscapes. 

Emaar Properties develop the residential series comprising Avena and Avena 2. Centrally located in The Valley Phase 2, residents have direct access to the central park, merging urban convenience with serene surroundings. Strategically situated on the Dubai—Al Ain Road, Avena 2 ensures easy access to all major areas of Dubai, making it an ideal choice for those seeking both relaxation and excitement in a community-focused setting.

characteristics_module.title: Enjoy Luxury Living Amidst Lush Green Spaces
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• A project by Emaar, an unprecedented real estate developer in the UAE
    Semi-detached villas are available in three distinct architectural styles: Gardenia A and B, Orchid A and B, and Lavender A and B.
  • Floor-to-ceiling windows in Emaar Avena 2 floor plan welcome in natural light and offer stunning views of verdant green landscapes
  • A strategic position of the villa community at Dubai-Al Ain Road ensures easy access to key areas of the city.
  • You can book the villa with just a 10% down payment, followed by easy instalments until June 2028.

location_tile.title: Elegance and Sustainability in the Heart of The Valley
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The Valley is a charming new community featuring modern townhouses and villas surrounded by beautifully landscaped urban gardens, shimmering sands, and lush green open spaces. This new phase combines the tranquility of nature with an active lifestyle, inviting you to immerse yourself in the serene environment and experience the lifestyle you've always dreamed of. Enjoy spaces designed for relaxation, play, and exploration, where inspiration is found amidst the vast, picturesque surroundings.

5 Minutes to Rugby Sevens Stadium
8 Minutes to Dubai Outlet Mall
25 Minutes to Burj Khalifa & Downtown Dubai
25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport

seo.metaDescription: Discover the luxury Avena 2 by Emaar Properties. Find out the floor plan of the 4-bedroom villas and amenities available in the community.

more_info.answer: Avena 2 offers elegant 4-bedroom villas designed for sustainable living, featuring spacious layouts, stylish interiors with natural tones, and three unique façade styles: Gardenia A and B, Orchid A and B, and Lavender A and B.
more_info.question: What types of properties are available in Avena 2 Emaar?

more_info.answer: Residents of Avena 2 can enjoy luxurious amenities, including private pools, large living areas with floor-to-ceiling windows, landscaped areas, an outdoor cinema, a kids’ playground, a fitness center, and 24/7 security.
more_info.question: What amenities can residents of Avena 2 expect?

more_info.answer: The villa complex is centrally located in The Valley, offering direct access to the central park. It is strategically situated on the Dubai—Al Ain Road, providing easy access to all major areas of Dubai.
more_info.question: Where is Emaar Avena 2 at The Valley located?

more_info.answer: Avena 2 is a project by Emaar, a master developer with a proven track record in delivering high-quality residential communities and developments in Dubai.
